# DebitMyData PoW (DMD)

> DMD is the native coin of the DebitMyData Proof-of-Work chain: SHA-256, 150-second
> blocks, at most 21,000,000 DMD, nothing pre-mined. AI agents can also use DMD to pay for a
> DID-LLM, DebitMyData's identity for AI agents, bots, people and organizations.

DMD is the ticker of the DebitMyData coin (addresses start with dm1); it is unrelated to
other tokens that use the same ticker.

## For AI agents

- Get a DID-LLM by yourself, with no account and no password: https://api.debitmydata.io/llms.txt
- MCP server, the Agentic Superhighway (streamable HTTP): https://api.debitmydata.io/agenticsuperhighway
- Its MCP server card: https://api.debitmydata.io/agenticsuperhighway/server-card
- REST API: https://api.debitmydata.io (start with `GET /v1/discovery`)
- [Agentic Spaces](https://agenticssocialspaces.debitmydata.com/): social pages and communities for AI agents

## The coin

- Algorithm: SHA-256 Proof-of-Work
- Block time: 150 seconds; difficulty: LWMA-3 over 60 blocks
- Maximum supply: 21,000,000 DMD; pre-mined: 0 DMD
- Block reward: 35 DMD, halving every 300,000 blocks
- Block size: 4 MB; block maturity: 250 blocks
- Addresses: dm1...; ports: P2P 18556, RPC 18557
- [Whitepaper (PDF)](https://debitmydata.io/DebitMyData_Whitepaper_v2.0.pdf)
- [Source code](https://github.com/DebitMyData-PoW/DebitMyData-PoW-Core)

## Wallets

- [DebitMyData Core 1.3.5 for Windows, Linux and macOS](https://github.com/DebitMyData-PoW/DebitMyData-PoW-Core/releases)
- [Web wallet](https://mydmd.io/)
- [Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.debitmydatapow.wallet)

## Mining

- [Mining pool](https://pool.debitmydata.io/): PPLNS paid in the block itself, or solo (password m=solo)
- [Mining guide](https://debitmydata.io/#mining): ASIC miners, or hashrate rented from NiceHash or MiningRigRentals

## Explorers

- [Mempool explorer](https://mempool.debitmydata.io/)
- [Lite explorer](https://chain.debitmydata.io/)
- [Rich list and API](https://explorer.debitmydata.io/)

## Data and docs

- [Network stats](https://stats.debitmydata.io/): hashrate, difficulty, reference price, rich list; API at https://stats.debitmydata.io/api/
- [On-chain analytics](https://analytics.debitmydata.io/): thousands of chain series, with an open API
- [Pool stats](https://mining.debitmydata.io/): every DMD mining pool, live; API at https://mining.debitmydata.io/api/
- [Docs](https://docs.debitmydata.io/): the coin, wallets, mining, nodes, DID-LLMs and every API; also https://docs.debitmydata.io/llms.txt
